doc: R2b-activation display transforms for train (the live-home slice). SEMANTIC judgment only — the design applies per-type display forms (data.jsx TYPE_META + the rendered mockup) the pure reverse-lookup can't infer from a frozen capture: type's enum .wire is lowercase ('distance') but the card label is title-case ('Distance'); target is whole-seconds in the seed but the card shows minutes for time-type (240 sec -> 4); unit's raw .wire ('sec'/'reps') differs from the per-type label the card shows ('minutes'/'reps total'). The transform expands the reverse-lookup's match cores AND emits a Dart wrapper so the runtime shows the design's display form, not the raw value (without it every card would render w1's frozen 'Distance'/'5'/'km'). Conditional `by: type` branches pick a transform per-row at runtime; '_' is the identity default. Exclude is the chrome-class list (shop's precedent). NEVER layout — only display.
